last.verdict: Investors liked the profit beat and bigger buyback, shrugging off a slight revenue miss.

reasons.label: Big profit beat
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $2.06 beat the roughly $1.85 expected and rose from $1.61.

reasons.label: Parks and cruises strong
reasons.text: Parks and cruise revenue rose 10%; profit up 20%, helped by a $100M tariff refund.

reasons.label: Bigger buyback, guidance held
reasons.text: Share repurchases raised to at least $9 billion; full-year earnings growth outlook reiterated.

story: Disney has delivered steady profit beats under new CEO Josh D'Amaro while holding its growth targets. Streaming profit and parks have driven results. The stock jumped about 7% after the May report on streaming strength and rose again now.
